title: The Long-Awaited GTA 6 Is Finally Out! 🎮
body: The Long-Awaited GTA 6 Is Finally Out! 🎮
After years of waiting and leaks, one of the most anticipated games in history has finally launched, amid huge excitement from players around the world.
Are you one of those who waited? And what's the first thing you'll do in the game? 👇
